versions.name: Camp Royce-Finel
versions.summary: A primitive Cascade Pacific Council camp, formerly Camp Cullaby, at the northeast end of Cullaby Lake near Warrenton on the northern Oregon coast, with tarp-shelter campsites, canoeing, and a hiking trail to the beach.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Cascade Pacific Council camp page. The scout-camp-map 'Oregon Trail Council' label is wrong: Camp Royce-Finel (formerly Camp Cullaby) is a Cascade Pacific Council property. Coordinates from the council's published GPS (approximate); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified against the council's camp page; classified as a primitive weekend camping property; features unsurveyed.
